hooks.name: Record Prompt When Task Completes
hooks.description: Automatically record task completions to .specstory/history/ with timestamp and task details

action.command:
powershell -Command "
$taskInfo = $input | ConvertFrom-Json
$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$fileName = '.specstory/history/prompt-{0}.md' -f $timestamp

# Create the prompt record (simplified, can be enhanced)
$content = @\"
# Prompt: Task Completion

**Date:** $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd')
**Time:** $(Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss') UTC
**Task:** $($taskInfo.taskName)
**Status:** Completed

## Task Summary
$($taskInfo.description)

## Files Referenced
- Check git diff for actual changes

## Next Steps
Continue with remaining tasks or start implementation.
\"@

# Write to file if directory exists
if (Test-Path '.specstory/history') {
    Set-Content -Path $fileName -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Output \"Recorded prompt to $fileName\"
}
"
